subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 23, 2026
body:
AcreetionOS gets a dedicated wallpapers repo

AcreetionOS now has a permanent home for its artwork. The acreetionos-wallpapers repo went live today with its initial commit and a backgrounds submodule that tracks the AcreetionOS GitLab repo, so every official background lives in one browsable, forkable place instead of being scattered across builds.

Development
The AcreetionOS-Xlibre tree got two quiet but welcome fixes: a bottom-bar icon that refused to be clicked now responds like it should, and the base image now ships the latest Electron so fresh installs start on current code rather than a few versions behind. On the website side, a Content Security Policy fix cache-busts the page-status.js reference — a handful of edge nodes had cached a pre-deploy 404, and this closes that gap. Full details as always land in the changelog at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html.

Community
Worth a look outside our own repos. Kernel prepatch 7.4-rc4 is out for testing — Linus called it "huge," with lots of little fixes spread all over the tree. Vim Classic shipped 8.3.1, and Beyls is wrapping up LLVM's relicensing effort, the kind of long, unglamorous work that keeps the toolchain trustworthy. Co-Lead Dev Darren Clift (Calamares dev and our ISO maintainer) keeps us close to all of it, while Co-Creator Natalie Spiva handles the frontend and design side. If you want the upstream chatter we actually read, it's collected in the wiki at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html.

Tip of the day
If you're already running AcreetionOS-Xlibre, grab the newest build from https://acreetionos.org/flash.html — the Electron bump and the panel-icon fix are the kind of thing you only notice once they're gone. Fresh installs pick it up automatically. And if you fork the wallpapers repo, keep your backgrounds submodule synced; a quick submodule update keeps your set matched to upstream instead of quietly drifting.
